usedFor: Farmbrite holds harvests, orders and tasks, and Google Docs receives the text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Crop Harvest” in Farmbrite, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each harvest entry becomes text in a document tab, giving you a written log.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes into one chosen tab, so give each Farmbrite record type its own tab.
